decisions.reason: Despite weak recent visibility, this adjustable cardboard quarter-pallet display remains very close to the core range and can still be carried at modest cost while management tests whether it meets customer demand.

After several years without clear visibility or differentiation from other quarter-pallet cardboard displays, this overlapping variant likely underperforms aspiration and is a sensible candidate for withdrawal.
The eighth-pallet display is still related to the firm's core offer, but its narrower application and limited observed prominence make resource reallocation more likely than continued support.

Because the wooden display pallet is less central to the paper-based core and appears not to have shown strong enough results, management would likely redeploy its resources to the established business or new projects.

This media-focused quarter-pallet display serves a specialized niche, and without evidence of sustained traction management would likely discontinue it in favor of broader display lines and new development.
